```{r}
#| label: tbl-vars
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| tbl-cap: "Variable definitions and data sources"
#| tbl-pos: "H"

vars <- tibble(var = names(pop))

# meta data
meta <- bind_rows(
  metaout,
  metalm %>%
    rename(Code = ATC) %>%
    mutate(Code = paste0("ATC ", Code))
)

vars <- full_join(vars, meta, by = c("var" = "Variable")) %>%
  mutate(
    order = 1:n()
  )

vars <- vars %>%
  arrange(order) %>%
  mutate(
    Register = case_when(
      Register == "Dispensed Drug Registry" ~ "NPDR",
      str_detect(var, "scb_") ~ "LISA",
      str_detect(var, "snr_") ~ "Svenskt Njurregister",
      TRUE ~ Register
    ),
    Code = str_trim(Code),
    Code = str_remove_all(Code, "\\^|\\(|\\)"),
    Code = str_replace_all(Code, "ICD", "ICD-10"),
    Code = str_replace_all(Code, ":", " "),
    Code = str_replace_all(Code, ",", ", "),
    Period = case_when(
      str_detect(var, "scb_") ~ "Year preceeding baseline",
      var %in% c("lab_sodium", "lab_hb") ~ "-365-0. The value closest to baseline is selected. If there are multiple values on the same day the mean is calculated. Only out-patient values are included.",
      var %in% c("lab_egfr") ~ "-547-0. The value closest to baseline is selected. If there are multiple values on the same day the mean is calculated. Only out-patient values are included.",
      var == "snr_dialysis" ~ "-0",
      str_detect(var, "sos_com_") ~ str_remove(Period, "0-"),
      TRUE ~ Period
    ),
    Period = if_else(str_detect(var, "sos_com_"), paste0(Period, "-0"), Period),
    Position = case_when(
      str_detect(var, "sos_com_ex_transfusion") ~ "all",
      str_detect(var, "sos_com_ex|sos_com_hf|sos_com_hypertension") ~ "main",
      str_detect(var, "sos_com_") ~ "all",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(Variable = var) %>%
  select(-order)

default_kable(vars,
  escape = TRUE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  font_size = 8.5
) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "4.2cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "6cm") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(5, width = "6cm")
```
